name: Interpolate bad channels
summary: Interpolates the channels marked as bad in epoched MEG/EEG data with MNE-Python Epochs.interpolate_bads.
description: Reads MNE epochs, spatially interpolates every channel listed in info['bads'] and saves the epochs. Use it after marking bad channels to restore a full channel set before averaging or source analysis. The bads parameter is not read by the code; only channels already marked bad in the input are interpolated.

inputs.description: Epoched MEG/EEG data (meg-epo.fif) with bad channels marked in info['bads'].
inputs.requirements: Channel positions are needed for spatial interpolation.

outputs.description: The input epochs with bad channels interpolated (meg-epo.fif).

parameters.description: Not read by the code; mark bad channels in the input data instead.
